_comment: AgriSync Voice Retained Storage - S3 Lifecycle Configuration
spec_id: voice-diary-e2e-2026-05-17
Owner: Kiro (AWS apply) + Akash (backend config)
STATUS: NoOp for Farm Memory. Verified 2026-08-23 against ADR-DS-017;
spec: dfes-companion-2026-07-11 (farm-memory).
Voice clips stay in S3 STANDARD indefinitely. There is no expiration
rule and no storage-class transition in this configuration, which is
what ADR-DS-017 (b) requires: Farm Memory does not expire on a clock,
and no infrastructure rule may quietly reintroduce one.
CORRECTION 2026-08-23: this block used to read "indefinitely so long as
the user retains FullHistoryJournal consent". That is no longer true and
must not be re-adopted as an assumption by anyone editing this file.
Withdrawing FullHistoryJournal stops FUTURE voice being saved; it does
NOT delete voice already saved (ADR-DS-017 (c)). Farm Memory ends only
on explicit deletion, account closure, or a legal requirement, all of
which run through the backend ErasureWorker. The correction is to the
comment only - the Rules array below was already correct and is
unchanged, so nothing needs re-applying to the bucket.
The single rule below cleans up *failed multipart uploads* after 7 days.
An incomplete upload is founder ITEM 5 category B - a technical artifact
with no continuing value to the farmer - so it keeps its short technical
rule and is deliberately NOT touched by the Farm Memory decision.
PHASE 07 (deferred per founder scope decision 2026-05-17; a Glacier
transition is a COMMENTED NOTE with no active effect, and any future
version of it must not carry an expiration):
- Glacier Instant Retrieval transition for clips older than N days
- Glacier Deep Archive transition for clips older than M months
- Object Lock for compliance retention (DPDP rights audit trail)
- Versioning + MFA-Delete (if multi-actor erasure becomes a requirement)
See: _COFOUNDER/Projects/AgriSync/Specs/_active/DATA_PRINCIPLE_SPINE_2026-05-05/
07_[27]_AUDIO_DIARY_RETAINED_STORAGE.md
APPLY (via create-bucket.sh, or manually):
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration \
--bucket shramsafal-voice-retained-${env} \
--lifecycle-configuration file://lifecycle-policy.json \
--region ap-south-1
VERIFY:
aws s3api get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration \
--bucket shramsafal-voice-retained-${env} \
--region ap-south-1
